name: field-history
title: Field History
description: A trigger beside the label flags a recent change by someone else and opens "Was ₹500 until Priya changed it yesterday" with a one-tap revert of that field alone, says what the revert replaces (including your unsaved edit) and lets you undo it.

meta.summary: Flags a field someone else just changed and shows its previous value with a one-tap revert, so a teammate's change isn't overwritten unknowingly.
catches: Recent changes by someone else (within recentFor)
The previous value and who changed it
Reverts that would also replace your unsaved edit
Regret after a revert, with Undo
limits: History comes from your props; it doesn't track changes itself
a11y: Pass htmlFor so the label is a real <label> for the field
The trigger has aria-expanded, aria-controls and an aria-label that says when it changed
